title: Animating Coraline - Behind the Scenes | LAIKA Studios
speaker: LAIKA Studios

cues.text: Coraline is fearless.
cues.en: Coraline is fearless.
cues.zh: 卡蘿蘭無所畏懼。

cues.text: She's an explorer.
cues.en: She's an explorer.
cues.zh: 她是一位探險家。

cues.text: She's independent.
cues.en: She's independent.
cues.zh: 她很獨立。

cues.text: She's curious.
cues.en: She's curious.
cues.zh: 她很好奇。

cues.text: But most importantly, she's self-reliant.
cues.en: But most importantly, she's self-reliant.
cues.zh: 但最重要的是，她很自力更生。

cues.text: Coraline had nine costumes.
cues.en: Coraline had nine costumes.
cues.zh: 卡蘿蘭有九套服裝。

cues.text: Her raincoat moved as one big unit.
cues.en: Her raincoat moved as one big unit.
cues.zh: 她的雨衣像一個大整體一樣移動。

cues.text: It was like animating a bell, on top of your costume.
cues.en: It was like animating a bell, on top of your costume.
cues.zh: 這就像在你的服裝之上啟動一個鈴鐺。

cues.text: The places that you could move it were at the bottom edge where there was wire.
cues.en: The places that you could move it were at the bottom edge where there was wire.
cues.zh: 你可以移動它的地方是底部邊緣有電線的地方。

cues.text: The end of the cuffs had wire, and the hood was wired
cues.en: The end of the cuffs had wire, and the hood was wired
cues.zh: 袖口末端有鐵絲，連帽也有鐵絲

cues.text: so you could get some bounce to it.
cues.en: so you could get some bounce to it.
cues.zh: 這樣你就可以得到一些反彈。

cues.text: And with those three points of articulation, we figured out a way to make it move naturally.
cues.en: And with those three points of articulation, we figured out a way to make it move naturally.
cues.zh: 透過這三個關節點，我們找到了一種讓它自然移動的方法。

cues.text: On the flip side, the star sweater was form fitting on her.
cues.en: On the flip side, the star sweater was form fitting on her.
cues.zh: 另一方面，星星毛衣很合身。

cues.text: You could see the shape of her torso as you were animating, but it was loose enough
cues.en: You could see the shape of her torso as you were animating, but it was loose enough
cues.zh: 當你製作動畫時，你可以看到她軀幹的形狀，但它足夠寬鬆

cues.text: that the animator was able to tease the sweater up and tease it down,
cues.en: that the animator was able to tease the sweater up and tease it down,
cues.zh: 動畫師能夠把毛衣撩起來或放下來，

cues.text: frame by frame, to give the illusion that she was breathing.
cues.en: frame by frame, to give the illusion that she was breathing.
cues.zh: 逐幀拍攝，給人一種她正在呼吸的錯覺。

cues.text: With so many unique costumes, each with its own look and feel,
cues.en: With so many unique costumes, each with its own look and feel,
cues.zh: 有這麼多獨特的服裝，每件都有自己的外觀和感覺，

cues.text: it really brought a sense of authenticity to Coraline's character.
cues.en: it really brought a sense of authenticity to Coraline's character.
cues.zh: 它確實為卡蘿蘭的角色帶來了真實感。

cues.text: It’s Coraline.
cues.en: It’s Coraline.
cues.zh: 這是卡蘿蘭。

cues.text: Caroline what?
cues.en: Caroline what?
cues.zh: 卡羅琳什麼？

cues.text: Coraline! Coraline Jones.
cues.en: Coraline! Coraline Jones.
cues.zh: 卡蘿蘭！卡洛琳瓊斯。
